name: Exile

components.pose: She kneels alone among cold ash with her wings drooping and a few black feathers falling around her, one hand resting on the ground and her face lifted to the camera, weary and unrepentant; full figure visible.
components.effects: Black feathers and fine ash drift down around her and drifting shadow, smoke and pale starlight lie dim and low along the ground, a faint {{MAGIC}} ember in her open hand.

notes: DUTY: Exile, for her alignment (rank 10); from data/art/_settings/scene-recipes.json.
